reconcile.note: Keil and Delitzsch treat the Deuteronomy 23:1 eunuch exclusion as a temporary ordinance for Israel's infancy that Isaiah 56 supersedes once God's kingdom opens to all nations.

sides.snippet: shall not enter into the assembly of Yahweh.
sides.verseText: He who is wounded in the stones, or has his privy member cut off, shall not enter into the assembly of Yahweh.

sides.snippet: a name better than of sons and of daughters
sides.verseText: To them will I give in my house and within my walls a memorial and a name better than of sons and of daughters; I will give them an everlasting name, that shall not be cut off.
